newsitem.title: USA: Casino fined $250,000 after 12-year-old plays slots.
newsitem.headline: Casino fined $250,000 after 12-year-old plays slots.

text.p: The owners of a Missouri casino were fined $250,000 Tuesday after state officials said a 12-year-old girl managed to gain entry and play a slot machine.
The Missouri Gaming Commission said the incident occurred Feb. 20 at the Casino St. Charles while the girl's mother was patronising the facility owned by Station Casinos Inc. of Las Vegas.
State law does not allow people under 21 to enter or gamble at casinos.
The owners of the gambling boat said the fine was excessive and that three employees involved in the incident had been fired.
